degree_rationale: Pre-existences before each malformation/binding/birth — fossae prepared before places-of-deceit, sea-prow before separation, gehennas before Error, prison before Watchers, twelve cities before Giants' sons. Illumines the pre-arrangement-mechanism.
direction_rationale: Wisdom showing 'beforehand-before' — the foreseen ordering. Illumination by retrospective unveiling of providential preparation.
grand_man_function: Spiritual pre-establishment — illumined providence in cosmic preparation.
title: More on the malformations: how seed-poison contrasts with form
